name: MapWindow
args: style: background (string, ""), cloudY (number, 360), cloudTime (number ms, 20000), yFar (0), yNear (400), farScale (1), nearScale (1) + TWindow keys
note: Registered by AddWindowType (not in ui/style.lua). Has no Lua-visible children; builds a sprite tree and one Rollover child per non-hidden port.

name: InitiateTravel
args: table t: path (list of {x,y}) or dest {mapx,mapy}; type (list of {fraction, modeName}); events (list of {time ms, action function}); other keys (time, dest when path given) ignored
note: Global set in the MapWindow constructor, closure bound to this window; set to nil in the destructor (0002a63c). No-op if this+0x6c (pTravelTask) is already non-null, which stays true for the life of the window.

name: PauseTravel
note: If a travel task exists: TAnimTask::Pause (next-run time = -1, ready flag 0) and travelPaused (this+0x68) = 1. No-op without a task. Global is nil when no MapWindow exists.

name: ResumeTravel
note: If a travel task exists: virtual +0x18 (TOldScalingTask::Restart) with 30 ms, which re-baselines the task clock so paused time is not counted, then travelPaused = 0.

name: MapWindow::CollectPortData
note: Iterates _AllPorts; builds marker sprites, labels, Rollover windows and the current-port ring.

name: MapWindow::OnTaskAnimate
note: Window animation tick (30 ms): cloudTime += 30, UpdateClouds, invalidate screen.

name: MapWindow::WindowToggleForeground
note: App focus lost: stop animation, open pause dialog via Lua string if not paused and map is top modal. Focus regained: restart animation, resume travel if not paused.

name: MapWindow::Draw
note: Draws the root background sprite tree at (0,0), scale 1, then TWindow::Draw.

name: TravelTask
note: TOldScalingTask subclass, 0x64 bytes. Moves the vehicle sprite along the curve, drops trail dots, switches vehicle mode, fires events.

name: TravelTask::AddEvent
note: Appends to event list, raises duration to max(event time), rewinds the event cursor to the list head.

name: TravelTask::SetMode
note: Prefix image/ if no slash, suffix .xml if no dot, load animated texture, set on the vehicle sprite.

name: TravelTask::TravelEvent::Trigger
note: Pushes the Lua function and calls TScript virtual +0x14 (inferred InjectFunction).

name: TCurve
note: Chain of cubic Beziers, 3n+1 points, arc-length parameterised through adaptive subdivision.

name: TCurve::GetPoint
note: t>=1 returns the end point, t<=0 the start point (tangent untouched in both), else walks subdivisions by arc length.

name: TCurve::GetLength
note: Total polyline length; triggers subdivision if needed and there are at least 4 points.

name: TCurve::Subdivide
note: Recursive de Casteljau; stops when control-polygon length minus chord <= 0.2 (_ACCEPTABLE_ERROR at 0x1d80e0).

name: TPathSprite
note: Not used on the world map. Used by PortWindow for cars, boats etc.
